values.name: Carrier loads
values.description: Carrier loads The cargo is loaded in the equipment by the carrier.

values.name: Full loads
values.description: Full loads Container to be stuffed or stripped under responsibility and for account of the shipper or the consignee.

values.name: Less than full loads
values.description: Less than full loads Container to be stuffed and stripped for account and risk of the carrier.

values.name: Shipper loads
values.description: Shipper loads The cargo is loaded in the equipment by the shipper.

values.name: To be delivered
values.description: To be delivered The cargo is to be delivered as instructed.

values.name: To be kept
values.description: To be kept The cargo is to be retained awaiting further instructions.

values.name: Transhipment allowed
values.description: Transhipment allowed Transhipment of goods is allowed.

values.name: Transhipment not allowed
values.description: Transhipment not allowed Transhipment of goods is not allowed.

values.name: Partial shipment allowed
values.description: Partial shipment allowed Partial shipment is allowed.

values.name: Partial shipment not allowed
values.description: Partial shipment not allowed Partial shipment is not allowed.

values.name: Partial shipment and/or drawing allowed
values.description: Partial shipment and/or drawing allowed Partial shipment and/or drawing is allowed.

values.name: Partial shipment and/or drawing not allowed
values.description: Partial shipment and/or drawing not allowed Partial shipment and/or drawing is not allowed.

values.description: Carrier unloads The cargo is to be unloaded from the equipment by the carrier.

values.name: Shipper unloads
values.description: Shipper unloads The cargo is to be unloaded from the equipment by the shipper.

values.name: Consignee unloads
values.description: Consignee unloads The cargo is to be unloaded from the equipment by the consignee.

values.name: Consignee loads
values.description: Consignee loads The cargo is to be loaded in the equipment by the consignee.

values.name: Exclusive usage of equipment
values.description: Exclusive usage of equipment Usage of the equipment is reserved for exclusive use.

values.name: Non exclusive usage of equipment
values.description: Non exclusive usage of equipment Usage of the equipment is not reserved for exclusive use.

values.name: Direct delivery
values.description: Direct delivery Consignment for direct delivery to the consignee.

values.name: Direct pick-up
values.description: Direct pick-up Consignment for direct pick-up from the consignee.

values.name: Request for delivery advice services
values.description: Request for delivery advice services The service provider is requested to advise about delivery.

values.name: Do not arrange customs clearance
values.description: Do not arrange customs clearance Indication that the recipient of the message is not to arrange customs clearance.

values.name: Arrange customs clearance
values.description: Arrange customs clearance Indication that the recipient of the message is to arrange customs clearance.

values.name: Check container condition
values.description: Check container condition Condition of the container is to be checked.

values.name: Damaged containers allowed
values.description: Damaged containers allowed Damaged containers are allowed.

values.name: Dirty containers allowed
values.description: Dirty containers allowed Dirty containers are allowed.

values.name: Fork lift holes not required
values.description: Fork lift holes not required Container needs not to be equipped with pocket holes, but they are allowed.

values.name: Fork lift holes required
values.description: Fork lift holes required Container must be equipped with pocket holes.

values.name: Insure goods during transport
values.description: Insure goods during transport Indication that the recipient of the message is to insure the goods during transport.

values.name: Arrange main-carriage
values.description: Arrange main-carriage Indication that the recipient of the message is to arrange the main-carriage.

values.name: Arrange on-carriage
values.description: Arrange on-carriage Indication that the recipient of the message is to arrange the on-carriage.

values.name: Arrange pre-carriage
values.description: Arrange pre-carriage Indication that the recipient of the message is to arrange the pre-carriage.

values.name: Report container safety convention information
values.description: Report container safety convention information Indication that the information on the Container Safety Convention plate (CSC-plate) should be reported.

values.name: Check seals
values.description: Check seals Sealing up of the container is to be checked.

values.name: Container must be clean
values.description: Container must be clean Container is to be released or delivered clean.

values.name: Request for proof of delivery
values.description: Request for proof of delivery The service provider is requested to provide proof of delivery.

values.name: Request for Customs procedure
values.description: Request for Customs procedure The service provider is requested to perform Customs procedure.

values.name: Request for administration services
values.description: Request for administration services The service provider is requested to perform administration services.

values.name: Transport insulated under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO
values.description: Transport insulated under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO conditions Insulated transport under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO (joint European railways agreement) conditions.

values.name: Transport mechanically refrigerated under Intercontainer
values.description: Transport mechanically refrigerated under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO conditions Mechanically refrigerated transport under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO (joint European railways agreement) conditions.

values.name: Cool or freeze service, not under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO
values.description: Cool or freeze service, not under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO conditions Cool or freeze service not under Intercontainer INTERFRIGO (joint European railways agreement) conditions.

values.name: Transhipment overseas
values.description: Transhipment overseas Transport equipment is to be transferred overseas.

values.name: Station delivery
values.description: Station delivery The specified equipment destination station is also the place of delivery of the goods.

values.name: Non station delivery
values.description: Non station delivery The specified equipment destination station is not the place of delivery of the goods.

values.name: Cleaning or disinfecting
values.description: Cleaning or disinfecting The service required is cleaning or disinfection.

values.name: Close ventilation valve
values.description: Close ventilation valve The ventilation valve of the equipment must be closed.

values.name: Consignment held for pick-up
values.description: Consignment held for pick-up The consignment is to be held until it is picked up.

values.name: Refrigeration unit check
values.description: Refrigeration unit check Refrigeration unit has to be checked.

values.name: Customs clearance at arrival country by carrier
values.description: Customs clearance at arrival country by carrier The carrier is to arrange customs clearance in the arrival country.

values.name: Customs clearance at departure country by carrier
values.description: Customs clearance at departure country by carrier The carrier is to arrange customs clearance in the departure country.

values.name: Heating for live animals
values.description: Heating for live animals Heating for live animals has to be provided.

values.name: Goods humidification
values.description: Goods humidification Humidification of the goods has to be performed.

values.name: Ensure load is secure
values.description: Ensure load is secure The load must be checked for correct stowage.

values.name: Open ventilation valve
values.description: Open ventilation valve The ventilation valve of the equipment must be opened.

values.name: Phytosanitary control
values.description: Phytosanitary control Phytosanitary control to be performed.

values.name: Tare check by carrier
values.description: Tare check by carrier Carrier must check the tare of the equipment and attached items.

values.name: Temperature check
values.description: Temperature check The temperature must be checked.

values.name: Weighing of goods
values.description: Weighing of goods The goods have to be weighed.

values.name: Escort
values.description: Escort An escort is required.

values.name: No escort
values.description: No escort An escort is not required.

values.name: Request for berthing services
values.description: Request for berthing services Request for berthing services at a specific berth in the port area.

values.name: Request for planned berth consideration
values.description: Request for planned berth consideration Request to take into account the planned next berth(s) in the port area.

values.name: Request for inbound passing services through port area
values.description: Request for inbound passing services through port area Request for passing services through port area for an inbound voyage (from sea to hinterland) without requesting berth in the port area.

values.name: Request for outbound passing services through port area
values.description: Request for outbound passing services through port area Request for passing services through port area for an outbound voyage (from hinterland to sea) without requesting berth in the port area.
